subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should cron ownership reconciliation live in this slice, land atomically as a companion, or should scheduler mutation be deferred until the Claws RFC is accepted?
rationale: The correctness gaps require a permanent recovery owner, while the open RFC explicitly says the current prototype is not yet the accepted compatibility contract.

options.title: Restack with full recovery
options.body: Include declaration adoption and idempotent owned-job cleanup in this cron ownership slice.

options.title: Require atomic companion
options.body: Keep the split only if a concrete reconciliation PR is reviewed and lands together with this branch.

options.title: Defer scheduler mutation
options.body: Retain portable cron declarations but postpone Gateway mutation until the lifecycle contract is accepted.

recommendation.title: Restack with full recovery
recommendation.body: Include declaration adoption and idempotent owned-job cleanup in this cron ownership slice.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent cron durability work and prior routing around Gateway convergence make this the strongest available owner for the product-boundary choice.
